from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Adjusting x to start further right to avoid overlapping lecture text
                x = 1.0 + j * 0.9 
                y = 2.2 - i * 0.9
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout(
            "The Cosmic Reunion", 
            [
                'This is the most beautiful equation in mathematics.', 
                'It unites five fundamental constants in one simple line.', 
                'Zero, one, e, i, and pi join together.', 
                'From the void of zero to the growth of e.', 
                'All connected in a single, elegant relationship.'
            ]
        )
        
        # Equation setup
        # Breakdown into specific parts for individual coloring and scaling
        eq = MathTex("e", "^{i", "\\pi}", "+", "1", "=", "0", font_size=60)
        # Indices based on the breakdown:
        # eq[0] = e
        # eq[1] = ^{i
        # eq[2] = \pi}
        # eq[4] = 1
        # eq[6] = 0
        
        self.place_in_area(eq, 'B2', 'E5', scale_factor=2.0)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.play(Write(eq), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight constant colors: e (#55FF55), i (#5555FF), pi (#FF5555), 1 (#FFFFFF), 0 (#AAAAAA)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.play(
            eq[0].animate.set_color("#55FF55"), # e
            eq[1].animate.set_color("#5555FF"), # i part
            eq[2].animate.set_color("#FF5555"), # pi part
            eq[4].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"), # 1
            eq[6].animate.set_color("#AAAAAA"), # 0
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        # Visual pulse of constants to show "joining"
        self.play(eq.animate.scale(1.1), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(eq.animate.scale(1/1.1), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#55FF55")
        # Pulse 'e' and show '0' highlight
        self.play(
            eq[0].animate.scale(1.5).set_color("#55FF55"),
            eq[6].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"), 
            run_time=1
        )
        self.play(
            eq[0].animate.scale(1/1.5),
            eq[6].animate.set_color("#AAAAAA"),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#FFFF88")
        
        # Scale up i and pi, glow and vibrate
        glow = eq.copy().set_color("#FFFF88").set_stroke(width=10, opacity=0.3)
        
        def vibrate_updater(mobj, dt):
            mobj.shift(np.random.uniform(-0.02, 0.02, 3))

        eq[1].add_updater(vibrate_updater)
        eq[2].add_updater(vibrate_updater)

        self.add(glow)
        self.play(
            eq[1].animate.scale(1.3),
            eq[2].animate.scale(1.3),
            FadeIn(glow),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Clean up updaters for smooth transition
        eq[1].remove_updater(vibrate_updater)
        eq[2].remove_updater(vibrate_updater)
        self.wait(1)
